app.title: Sampark
land.hero_body: People who cannot speak or hear are still shut out of the simplest thing: a phone call. Sampark turns the clerk’s voice into captions, you tap a reply suggestion, and only Send speaks — in Hindi or English.
land.lead: You lead. Sampark carries the conversation.
land.lead_body: Every signal that matters is on screen, so you are never guessing what is happening on the line.
land.shape: See the shape of every conversation.
land.shape_body: A phone call is more than a transcript. Connection, silence and the number worth keeping are clear on screen — and every call is saved when it ends.
land.depend: Calls should not depend on being able to speak or hear.
land.why_1: See whether the line is active, silent, or disconnected — a deaf user cannot hear hold music.
land.why_2: Reply suggestions stay suggestions. Nothing is spoken until you tap Send.
land.why_3: The outcome card keeps the complaint number on top. The full conversation stays collapsed.
land.footer: A phone relay for deaf and non-verbal India
land.step1_title: Enter only the facts this call needs
land.step1_body: Pick a situation first. Then add consumer number, area, or bank details — only what you typed. Sampark will not invent a number or a name.
land.step2_body: The clerk’s voice becomes live captions. A silence ring shows whether the line is active, quiet, or gone.
land.step3_body: Nothing is spoken until you approve the exact sentence. OTP, PIN, CVV and passwords are never spoken.
land.tl1_body: Sampark opens the line. The first sentence names you as an assistive relay.
land.tl2_body: You read the line, tap a reply suggestion, and press Send.
land.tl3_body: Pin it when you hear it. The outcome card keeps that number on top.
